scope: This guide is for a first club dirt oval event with a complete electric RC car. The rules below show how two tracks describe eligibility; they do not approve either example car for another venue or even a later event at the same track. Use the event organizer for race rules and the manufacturer’s exact manual for operating limits.
archiveIntent: An event-specific sequence for entry, class verification, scored practice and a first heat. Separate from general inspection, chassis setup, wheel fit and vehicle reviews.

findings.locator: Product features and chassis / owner’s manual BL-2s profile selection / RC Driver first run
findings.verified: 2WD low center of gravity platform with BL-2s electronics and designated transponder location; Race profile removes reverse while Training keeps it.

findings.locator: Product electronics and included battery / exact owner’s manual
findings.verified: Titan 12T and XL-5 with factory NiMH. The included battery differs from the hard-case 2S requirement in the cited class example.

findings.locator: Sport-Mod-Spec Slash and general race procedure
findings.verified: The 2022 example specifies chassis, motor, ESC, battery, gearing, body and tires. It documents transponder, missed-lap and marshal practices. Current event eligibility was not confirmed.

findings.locator: Modified Late Model, Modified Late Model – Spec Tire and Rookie
findings.verified: The 2026 classes have separate tire and eligibility rules; the modified classes call for buggy-based chassis and the rookie rules give the track discretion to reassign drivers.
A transponder identifier read at the loop is used by the timing system to count and time passes.
